author: Middendorff, 1853

months.note: 5~6월과 8~10월 이동기에 지나가고 11월 기록도 드물게 있으며, 번식지에서는 6월 하순~7월 상순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 한반도를 드물게 지나가는 나그네새이다. 풀 사이를 몰래 누비며 먹이를 찾고, 때때로 풀줄기에 앉아 지저귄다. 곤충을 주로 먹는다. 오호츠크해 서안, 샨타르섬, 캄차카, 사할린, 쿠릴 열도, 홋카이도 등지에서 번식하며 6월 하순~7월 상순에 한배에 5~6개, 흔히 5개의 알을 낳고, 중국 동부, 일본, 타이완, 필리핀, 보르네오, 셀레베스 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: short, indistinct greyish-white or buff supercilium
laterally compressed bill about half the head length

young: 어른새와 비슷하나 온몸에 노란 기가 돌아 윗면이 더 어두운 올리브 갈색이고 얼굴과 아랫면이 노르스름한 담황색을 띠며, 멱과 가슴에 흐린 얼룩이 있다.

similar.how: 섬개개비는 더 크고 부리와 꼬리가 길며, 윗면이 붉은 기 없이 잿빛을 띤 올리브 갈색이다.
북방개개비는 머리와 등에 검은 세로무늬가 뚜렷하고 흰 눈썹선이 또렷하다.

art.subject: Middendorff's Grasshopper Warbler (Locustella ochotensis), adult, as seen in Korean grassland during passage in May-June and August-September: upperparts plain, unstreaked rusty olive-brown, the crown slightly darker; a short, rather indistinct greyish-white to buff supercilium and greyish-white lores; olive-buff cheeks and ear coverts with fine dark brown tips; underparts buffy-white with a brownish wash across the breast and flanks; undertail coverts buff; tail rounded, dark brown with pale greyish-white tips to the outer feathers; bill with a horn-brown upper mandible and a paler pinkish to yellowish-horn lower mandible; dark brown eye; pale pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched on a grass stem, singing
art.scene: Korean grassy field during spring or autumn migration; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched on a grass stem: plain rusty olive-brown unstreaked upperparts, short faint pale supercilium, buffy-white underparts with brownish breast and flanks, long rounded tail with pale feather tips
adult, head detail in side view: laterally compressed bill about half the head length, horn-brown upper mandible and paler lower mandible, short indistinct pale supercilium, dark brown eye
art.build: Medium-sized skulking warbler, a little longer than a sparrow but slimmer, with a long rounded tail; crouching, horizontal posture, often creeping mouse-like through grass. Bill fairly stout, laterally compressed, about half the head length. Legs medium-length, pale buff to pinkish. Wings short; the graduated, rounded tail extends well beyond the wingtips, and the long undertail coverts are buff. Sometimes sits up on a grass stem to sing.
avoid: Do not paint dark streaks on the crown, back or breast - those mark Pallas's Grasshopper Warbler (Locustella certhiola) and Lanceolated Warbler.
Do not paint a square or forked tail; it is long, graduated and rounded.
Do not paint a long, bold, dark-bordered supercilium or bright yellow underparts.
